question: The correct order of the four stages of lifecycle of mosquitoes is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**egg, larva, pupa, imago**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **mosquito **goes through **four separate **and **distinct stages **of its **life cycle**:

 
 
• **Egg**.
 
• **Larva**.
 
• **Pupa**.
 
• **Adult**.
 
 
 
• **Each **of **these stages **can be **easily recognized **by its **special appearance**.
 
• The **life cycle **typically takes up **to two weeks**, but **depending on conditions**, it can **range from 4 days **to as long **as a month**.
 
• **Eggs **are held **one at a time **or **linked together **to form the **"rafts**." They hang on the external of the water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Egg **- hatches when exposed to water.
 
• **Larva **- **"wriggler" **lives in water; molts several times; most species surface to breathe air.
 
• **Pupa **- **"tumbler" **do not feed; stage just before emerging as adult.
 
• **Adult **- flies a short time after emerging and after its body parts have hardened
